# AMPri Handelsgesellschaft mbH

> > AMPri is a wholesale supplier of disposable hygiene and occupational safety products, including hand disinfectants, protective gowns, and medical-grade supplies based in Winsen/Luhe, Germany.

AMPri Handelsgesellschaft mbH specializes in professional hygiene solutions under brands like Safeline and Med-Comfort, offering hospital-grade disinfectants certified to EN standards and disposable protective equipment for medical and industrial applications.

## Key Topics

- AMPri Handelsgesellschaft mbH
- Disposable hygiene products
- Hand disinfection
- Safeline brand
- Med-Comfort brand
- EN 1500 and EN 12791 certification
- Occupational safety equipment
- Hospital-grade disinfectants
- Disposable visitor gowns
- Polypropylene (PP) materials
- Aldehyde-free formulations
- Wholesale trade
- GPSR compliance
- Winsen/Luhe operations
